text:
alex: Noticing a weird one — route evals showing default-route despite X-Tenant header present at gateway. Happened under canary traffic after yesterday's sampler tweak.
tara: Can you drop a trace id and example curl?
alex: trace-id 1769504321-7, replay id 437
curl -H 'X-Tenant: acme-corp' 'https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate'
Gateway logs show header; decision log payload missing X-Tenant.
kevin: Sounds like sampling payload trim. Sampler has header pruning to keep logs < 8kb. Did the request have large body / many metadata fields?
liam: Also check header normalization — envoy sometimes lowercases or merges headers. decision-logs ingestion expects canonical 'x-tenant' header.
observability-bot: decisionlog-ingest: dropped headers=['X-Tenant'] for trace=1769504321-7 reason='trimmed_by_sampler' (ingest-id=ing-789)
tara: Replayed the trace locally, I can reproduce: gateway->prefilter shows 'X-Tenant: acme-corp' then route-eval step has no header. Prefilter cache hit path?
alex: Repro seems limited to requests that hit prefilter + cache=true. Hypothesis: prefilter cache returns synthesized request object that omits some headers before rule-eval serialization.
kevin: Quick mitigation: add 'preserve_headers' list to sampling config or increase max_payload_bytes in collector. Longer fix: make prefilter preserve header map for decision logging.
liam: Agree. I'll open a tiny patch to tag 'x-tenant' as preserve_in_decision_log on the route matcher. Will also add a unit test for cached path.
tara: Can we also add a console toggle to force full decision-logs for a route during canary? That'd help debugging without flipping sampler globally.
alex: +1 — makes rollouts easier. Tara, want to own console toggle UX? I'll file the infra work item for collector change.
tara: Happy to. I'll post a short RFC and a repro snippet in the ticket.
kevin: Filing PRs: infra-collector #1123, route-matcher #1124, console-ux #1125. I'll coordinate rollback plan if this affects ingestion cost. :eyes:
alex: Thanks — ping me when PRs link in thread. I'll run a replay after patches are up.
